summary.plain: The Hall A set-up used for CREX: a calcium-48 target in the electron beam and two high-resolution spectrometers measuring electrons scattered elastically at a small angle.
summary.technical: Hall A high-resolution spectrometers with an isotopically enriched 48Ca target measuring the parity-violating asymmetry in elastic scattering of longitudinally polarised electrons.
